lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hello, I have a reservation. My name is Jieun.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Welcome! Let me check. Can you spell your last name, please?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It's J-I-E-U-N. I booked a single room for three nights.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Perfect, I see your reservation. Your room is on the fifth floor.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. Do I need to fill out any forms?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, you're all set. Here is your room key.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thank you so much. Which way is the elevator?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's right over there. Enjoy your stay!

carry_in: Jieun has arrived at her hotel in Manhattan
She is standing at the entrance, looking at the building
She is ready to check in
carry_out: Jieun has checked in successfully and received her room key
She is now heading to the elevator to go to her room
scene_state.emotion: relieved and happy to have checked in successfully
